component.description: Stratum-3E high-stability oven-controlled crystal oscillator (OCXO), voltage-controlled variant (VCOCXO). Overtone SC-cut quartz resonator in an ovenized 22 x 25 x 12.7 mm SMT package. This ordered grade OH300-50503CV-010.0M is: temperature code 5 (0 to 70 C), stability code 05 (+/-5 ppb over temperature), supply code 03 (3.3 Vdc), CMOS output, OCXO type V (voltage-controlled), 10.0 MHz. The OH300 series spans 5 to 50 MHz with +/-5/10/20/50 ppb stability grades; per note 1 the +/-5 ppb grade is available only over the 0-70 C and -20-70 C temperature ranges. Exercises the OCXO oven block (warm-up time/power, steady-state power, Allan deviation over averaging time, SSB phase noise over offset frequency) plus the VCOCXO control/tuning block. Targets cellular base stations, Synchronous Ethernet, VSAT, and Stratum-3E timing.

parameters.name: Frequency stability vs change in temperature

measurements.conditionsVerbatim: Frequency Stability vs. Change in Temperature, Stability Code 05: -5.0 to +5.0 ppb over the 0 to 70 C range (temperature code 5), calculated as [(Fmax-Fmin)/(2*Fo)] with control voltage at nominal (notes 1, 2). +/-5 ppb = +/-0.005 ppm.
Frequency Stability vs. Load: -2.0 to +2.0 ppb at +/-5% load change. +/-2 ppb = +/-0.002 ppm.
Frequency Stability vs. Voltage: -2.0 to +2.0 ppb at +/-5% Vcc change. +/-2 ppb = +/-0.002 ppm.
Aging: Daily, 5 MHz to 20 MHz band: -1.0 to +1.0 ppb/day, at time of shipment after 48 hours of operation (note 3). +/-1 ppb/day = +/-0.001 ppm (bounded per day, not a rate).
Aging: First Year, 5 MHz to 20 MHz band: -50 to +50 ppb. +/-50 ppb = +/-0.05 ppm.

Lifetime Tolerance (20 Years), 5 MHz to 20 MHz band: -300 to +300 ppb, inclusive of calibration, operating temperature, supply voltage change, load change and 20 years aging (note 4). +/-300 ppb = +/-0.3 ppm.
Supply Voltage (Vcc), Voltage Code 03: 3.13 / 3.30 / 3.47 Vdc. Vcc must be reached monotonically within a ramp-up time of <12 ms (note 5).
Supply Voltage (absolute maximum): -0.5 to 7.0 Vdc.
Warm Up Time @ 25 C: 5 minutes (max) = 300 s, measured within +/-100 ppb of final frequency, referenced one hour after turn-on (note 7).

Re-Stabilization Time table (off time -> re-stabilization time, to again meet daily-aging and short-term-stability requirements): <1 Hour -> <2 Hours; <6 Hour -> <12 Hours; <24 Hour -> <48 Hours; 1 to 16 Days -> 48 Hours + 1/4 Off Time; >16 Days -> <6 Days. Worst case for the shortest off time (<1 Hour off) is <2 Hours = 7200 s. The OH300 tabulates a re-stabilization TIME vs off-time (a time in s), not a frequency-retrace offset in ppm, so the retrace key is not used.
Power Consumption: Turn-On, 0 to 70 C Models: 3.00 W (max), measured with Vcc = nominal, in calm air (note 6).
Power Consumption: Steady State @ 25 C, 0 to 70 C Models: 1.10 W (max), Vcc = nominal, calm air (note 6).
Start-Up Time: 500 ms (max) = 0.5 s. The electronics start-up, distinct from the 5-minute oven warm-up.

Short Term Allan Deviation (1s), Fo = 10 MHz: 1.0E-11 (nominal/typical). Dimensionless fractional frequency at tau = 1 s ('RMS' removed from the units per revision 16). '1s' means at tau = 1 s, not a per-second rate.

notes: Ordered grade OH300-50503CV-010.0M decodes as: package OH300 (22x25 mm SMT), temperature code 5 (0 to 70 C), stability code 05 (+/-5.0 ppb over temperature), supply code 03 (3.3 Vdc), output code C (CMOS), OCXO type V (VCOCXO, voltage-controlled), 10.0 MHz. Per note 1, the +/-5 ppb stability grade is available only over the 0-70 C and -20-70 C temperature ranges.

Several specs are frequency-band dependent. At the ordered 10 MHz this document uses the 5-20 MHz aging band (daily +/-1 ppb, first-year +/-50 ppb, 20-year +/-300 ppb) and the 5-12 MHz phase-noise column (-85/-115/-140/-145/-150/-150 dBc/Hz). Higher-frequency bands (>20-40, >40-50 MHz) have larger aging and higher phase noise and would be a separate document per band.
ppb->ppm conversion (x1e-3) applied throughout: +/-5 ppb = 0.005 ppm, +/-2 ppb = 0.002 ppm, +/-1 ppb/day = 0.001 ppm, +/-50 ppb = 0.05 ppm, +/-300 ppb = 0.3 ppm.

CMOS output drive currents Ioh = -4 mA and Iol = 4 mA have no dedicated oscillator-dictionary key; they are captured as I_OUT conditions on output_high_voltage / output_low_voltage (the currents at which Voh/Vol are guaranteed).

The Re-Stabilization Time table (page 3) is a re-stabilization TIME vs off-time (in seconds), not a frequency-retrace offset in ppm. Per the dictionary retrace hint it is kept in conditionsVerbatim on a second warm_up_time measurement; the retrace key (unit ppm) is intentionally not used because this part specifies a time, not a ppm offset.

Sinewave-output specifications (output code S: Output Power 5.0 dBm min into 50 ohm, Harmonics -30 dBc, Spurious -80 dBc) are omitted because this ordered grade is CMOS output (code C). For reference, 5.0 dBm converts to 10^((5-30)/10) = 3.162e-3 W, which would populate the output_power key on a sinewave grade.
No holdover spec is printed (holdover is a GNSS-disciplined-module figure, not present on this bare OCXO).

Environmental Characteristics (shock 100 G, sinusoidal/random vibration, 70,000 ft altitude, moisture) and mechanical/package outline data are out of scope for the datasheet-schema electrical envelope and are not modeled.
